<!-- pr-reviewer: 458e8be2eeecdda6cf0ee1a379df6c95985219b2 -->

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a full review at head `458e8be2e`. No earlier collaborator review marker exists on this PR at the GitHub endpoints (0 reviews). The head is also not a descendant of the SHA cited in the review context; the whole branch was read.

## What looks good

- The refusal law is visible at each step. A plan from the air whose worst reading passes the load bound returns `refused` with no passes. The level then goes to the Offset rings with a note. Nothing posts silently.
- A tagged fixture in the air band refuses generation by name. The message names the fixture. The post gate stays the second line. The new app tests pin both.
- The non-Adaptive band keeps the old computation exactly (`open_sides` keeps the `stock_band == r - OPEN_SLACK` path). A band below the open band is an error, not a quiet clamp. The `air` flag excludes shell and rest roughing.
- The two merges of main are clean. The hand resolution in `crates/motion/src/machining3d/entry.rs` keeps main's `cut_levels_under` ladder law and this branch's stock argument. The fix commit `458e8be2e` restores the imports the split needs after the merge. No crossing, load or budget law changed (`guard`, the budgets and the post gate are not touched).
- The indexing in the new planner is guarded: `split` gives pieces of at least two points, runs are filtered to length 2 or more, `loops()[0]` sits behind a `len() == 1` test, and the cell cast checks `is_finite` and a bound. `MAX_FRONTS` and `MAX_SPAN` end the loops on degenerate input.
- New modules carry provenance lines. Public sources are named. No vendor material is cited or used.
- The decision entry `docs/decisions/1950-adaptive-stock-ring-air.md` records the band, the joins, the air entry, the fixture refusal and the crossing law, with the readings.

## Results merged with main (local)

Built and tested in the review worktree on the head merged with main `88565c8a4`. The trial merge was clean.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

1. The PR title says "rounds A-B". The body says "Rounds A to E". The head also carries the round F, G and H commits. Please state the round range once, so the record reads clean.
2. The body line `Head: c3509172c...` is older than the head. The refresh comment covers it.
3. Two `ring_tests` pins stay red and are ignored with the reason "blocked after round H (maintainer decides)": 10 retract hops over 8, and a trim at the outer lap reads over the bound. This matches the body: the D plate level still goes to the Offset rings, and the PR does not close the issue. The maintainer decides the round F follow-up.
4. `open_footprint` now takes eight arguments and carries `#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]`. A small params struct would read better in a later pass.
5. `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` is 3831 lines and this PR adds 17. The growth is small; the file needs a split someday.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
